notes.title: Turn-Based Carnival - Whimsical Heroes Update
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of the new content patch for our demo as part of our participation in the Turn-Based Carnival on Steam!


In this update, we focused on enhancing skills. Both the heroes and their companions' skills can be developed while staying at the camp. Simply choose the equipment of the heroes near the campfire or one of the companions to open the development screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/258155170dfc40b74a2597856425041296acd829.png[/img]

Each learned skill has up to four different upgrades. Some increase damage, others reduce cooldown or required action points, while others give new properties to the skills. For example, upgraded Piercing will ignore the enemy's armor, and the False Note will hit more distant and numerous targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/3e11ab7acbca370c5f20d9ba4435bec049b9d64c.png[/img]

In addition to skill development, we also introduced improvements to the unit queue to support dynamic changes in initiative. And you know what? Chasing not only increases action points but also boosts initiative. Empowered by it, a hero will not only go farther but also earlier.

Last but not least, we've given a more unique atmosphere to the locations our heroes travel through. The forest is now darker, and Baba-Yaga's domain may seem a bit gloomy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/89cf5837080aa39c26ccff50c67924f481ae7ee7.png[/img]

Since the demo was released, we have already published several important updates. If you want to know more about the changes we're making, have access to behind-the-scenes work, and influence the development of Whimsical Heroes, join our [url=https://discord.gg/7gHKxVYGyT]Discord[/url] now.

notes.title: Development of Bubbleland
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Bubbleland is an independent game, a passion project, which we carry out in our spare time. Although working in a tiny team is quite challenging, a great creative freedom is one of its advantages. 

Today we would like to tell you what stage of production we are at.

[list]
[*]The game is functional already, most of the mechanics have been implemented, and now the biggest challenge is, and will be until the end of production, creating the game content - graphics, sounds, music and encounters.
[*]Recently, the game has been enriched with a lot of new graphic and animation assets of characters, items and background elements. The background itself moves more beautifully than ever during the character's journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/f09f54c6084089398a181b816bfd6be5f23e85ff.gif[/img]

[*]The system of the adventure scenes has changed! Player's party will not only fight battles, but also search the levels for  treasures, interact with other characters and choose the paths they want to follow.
[*]Battle music now changes dynamically depending on which side of the conflict is closer to victory.
[*]Existing battles have had their difficulty balanced, and opponents have gained new skills.
[*]Countless improvements to the game's operation and the display of the interface have been implemented. 
[/list]
Thanks for your interest in our game! If you want to support us more, add Bubbleland to your Wishlist - it motivates us to further work and shows that there are people waiting for us to provide them with the best possible experience.

Also check out our other social media, where we will share further information and behind the scenes materials:
[b][list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/BubblelandGame]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/bubblelandgame/]Instagram[/url]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHVGGoJ4AaYN9Wcl98X3TQA/]Youtube[/url]
[/list][/b]

[/list]
